ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in a continuous perimeter band and discrete interior focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity banding along the entire trailing edge. A series of discrete, low-intensity circular blobs are mapped to the distal region of the right lobe. A singular linear low-intensity feature extends diagonally from the median notch into the mid-section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 50 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude and jaggedness observed at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges, sweeping upward and outward from the median notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of approximately 10-15 roughly circular dark pixel groups on the right lobe (upper-right quadrant), consistent with barnacle attachment sites. Isolated circular marks present on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal dark linear disruption extending from the median notch toward the lower-left ventral region. Several shorter, faint horizontal linear marks visible near the trailing edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged loss of tissue/contour on the far-right lobe tip; multiple circular scars and linear rake-like markings across both lobes.
